senses.gloss:
तुल् तुल् (akin to तॄ), i. 10, तोलय and तुलय, Par. (also Ātm. Rām. 4, 9, 100), † i. 1, Par.
 1. To lift, Rām. 3, 4, 44.
 2. To weigh, MBh. 3, 10588.
 3. To ponder, MBh. 12, 2394.
 4. To suspect, Mṛcch. 33, 5.
 5. To compare, Bhāg. P. 5, 5, 23.
 6. To equal, Megh. 65.
 7. To attain, Ragh. 13, 75.
 --With the prep. आ आ, To lift, Rām. 1, 34, 10 Gorr.
 --With सम् सम्, To weigh, together, MBh. 13, 2607.
 --Cf. Lat. tollo, tuli, latum (for tlatum); ταλάω, τάλας, τλῆσις, τάνταλος (Frequent.), ἀντλέω (for ταντλέω, Frequent.), ὄτλος, τέλος (office), τέλλω, ἐντολή, τόλμα, τάλαντον; Goth. thulan; A.S. tholian, thyldian, athylgian.

† तूल् तूल्, i. 1 and 10, To weigh (cf. तुल्).
 --i. 10, Ātm. = तूण्.

तुलन तुल् + अन, n.
 1. Lifting, Mṛcch. 146, 25.
 2. Taxing, 50, 16.
तुलसिका तुलसिका, i. e. तुलसी + क, and तुलसी तुलसी, f. A small shrub, held in veneration by the Hindus, holy basil, Bhāg. P. 3, 15, 19; 1, 19, 6.

तुला तुल् + आ, f.
 1. A balance, Man. 8, 403.
 2. Weight, MBh. 3, 10385.
 3. The beam of a balance, MBh. 12, 9350.
 4. Equality, Ragh. 19, 50; Megh. 93.
 5. The sign of the zodiac, Libra, Pañc. i. d. 375.
 6. A measure or weight of gold and silver = 100 palas, MBh. 14, 1929.
 --Comp.

तूल तूल, m. and n. Cotton, MBh. 1, 6740.
 --Comp.

तुल्य तुल्य, i. e. तुला + य, adj., f. या,
 1. Equal, Brāhmaṇ. 1, 31; with the gen. Rām. 1, 7, 17; and the instr. Man. 4, 86.
 2. Indifferent, Bhāg. P. 1, 5, 24.
 3. Being of the same class, Man. 8, 364.
 4. ˚यम्, adv. Equally, Rām. 6, 90, 31.
 --Comp.
तुल्यता तुल्य + ता, f. and तुल्यत्व तुल्य + त्व, n. Equality, Rām. 1, 4, 7 Gorr.; Prab. 27, 14.
तुल्यशस् तुल्य + शस्, adv. In equal parts, Suśr. 2, 327, 13.
तूलक तूल + क, n. Cotton, Bhāṣāp. 112.

तूलिका तूलिका, i. e. तूल + क, f.
 1. A pencil, Kumāras. 1, 22.
 2. A mattress filled with cotton, Kathās. 26, 78.
तुल्य- + दर्शन तुल्य- + दर्शन, adj. indifferent, Bhāg. P. 1, 5, 24.
तुला- + धारण तुला- + धारण, n. weighing, Yājñ. 2, 100.
तुला- + पुरुष तुला- + पुरुष, m. 1. a person weighed in a balance, i. e. a present of gold or other precious things of equal weight. 2. the name of a penance.
तुला- + यष्टि तुला- + यष्टि, the beam of a balance, Pañc. i. d. 166.
तुल्य- + विक्रम तुल्य- + विक्रम, adj. fought with equal prowess, Hit. iii. d. 1.
